jobs.title: Jirayauma

request.prompt:
EDIT the provided OWN AI ART into a DIFFERENTIATED new character DESIGN sheet. Keep the whole-body front/side/back layout, paper medium and complete forest world; change the identity features and adornment/clothing design in ALL three views as specified, do not simply decorate one view.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: new model sheet for the Huitoto / Murui-Muina visual bible, an original editorial adaptation of credited published Amazonian narratives.
PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: unmistakable, expressive PHYSICAL CUT PAPER, stronger relief and visible construction than a softly textured illustration. Everything is built out of individually cut, folded, curled, interleaved dyed matte PAPER pieces. At first glance the viewer must immediately recognize scissors-cut paper and the real shadows of separated pieces. Show 8 to 12 major overlapping spatial layers, deep stepped silhouettes, genuine empty air between layers, sharply legible inner edges with narrow lighter paper thickness, broad short directional cast shadows, occlusion and contact shadows. Larger foliage sheets fold along their midrib and curl off the plane; fine fibres are actual narrow cut-paper strips. Paper thickness and depth are exaggerated enough to remain readable in a thumbnail, without making every surface busy. Solid colour sheets with restrained visible fibre and small hand-cut irregularities, not a photographic texture filter. Approximately 0.5 to 1 mm paper edges, 3 to 12 mm apparent separation between world planes, varied depending on subject; these are art-making instructions, not measurements of the depicted cultural objects.
Lighting: a consistent warm broad directional light from the upper left, fairly strong diagonal shadows toward the lower right, soft enough to feel editorial, never black theatrical gloom. Clear foreground / middle / distance separation with atmosphere made from physical pale paper layers, not fog effects. A continuous quiet deep forest world fills all image edges. No visible perimeter of a diorama, backing board, base, platform, table, studio, white surround, vignette, picture frame or cutout hole encircling the entire image. The scene extends beyond all four boundaries. Supporting views sit in continuous contextual space without dividing lines or bordered panels. Complete bodies and main objects are fully in frame with breathing room.
Palette continuity: forest green #385745, young green #8C9B58, burnt terracotta #B95737, blue-grey river #304852, cream fibre #CBB389, earth #806348, charcoal #343733, warm pale paper #F3EBDD. Colours are editorial choices, not a community symbolic code. Allow richer light/dark contrast to expose cut-paper layering. HUMAN CHARACTER ACCENTS are much more vivid than the forest: dyed PAPER feather emerald #2F8850, cobalt #356AB5, scarlet #C74433, golden yellow #D5A833. Not rainbow garments: place colour selectively in specific feathers, pigment-paper and seed ornaments. These are original art choices, not certified clan colour codes.
Human faces, when requested, have natural adult proportions, individual fictional features, a few quiet nearly-flat shaped PAPER pieces and minimal eyes; no low-poly faceting, doll heads or generic racial caricature. Clothing is physically folded fibrous cream paper, with truly cut loose fringe and separate flat dark-paper appliques where requested. Clothing shapes continue the reviewed reconstruction, not modern commercial dress and not claimed a dated universal traditional uniform. Do not copy any living person's portrait or body-paint pattern.
No text, letters, labels, numbers, arrows, logo or watermark. No added people or animals except exactly requested. No invented clan symbols, runes, glow, aura, European fantasy or universal ceremonial costume. No photoreal wood, dirt, water, clay or fabric; no smooth digital painting, photomontage, glossy plastic, resin, sculpted CGI or blurred depth that hides construction. Maintain requested anatomy. No sexualisation, exposed genitalia, gore or explicit violence.

PRIMARY SUBJECT: Three COMPLETE FRONT, exact SIDE and BACK views of the SAME fictional adult, maintaining face, hair, body, clothes and the exact ornament layout across views. All heads, hand fingers and bare feet within image. Three entire bodies approximately 65 percent image height. One SMALL separate face-and-ornament close study can appear at upper edge but never replaces the whole bodies.
CHARACTER DESIGN: Jirayauma: long strong cheekbones, wider long nose, medium lips, straight black hair to shoulders. A striking UPRIGHT SHORT GREEN feather CORONET on woven plant-fibre base, individual olive/emerald feathers with dark tips and TWO cobalt side feathers. Fine pale QUILL nasal ornament across septum, small and clearly visible. One sparse necklace of SIX curved pale tooth-shape PAPER pendants interspersed with black and red seed PAPER beads. Two original curved charcoal cheek strokes and short chin line, two separated thin white upper-arm PAPER stripes. Keep NARROW unpainted beaten-bark front/back loincloth flaps, waist cord and complete long blowpipe. This hunter has a strong green upright silhouette, not a generic cream-band man.
CULTURAL BASIS: original editorial interpretation of the credited myth. Historic Witoto feather head-dresses are documented in Whiffen1915 chapterV plateXI; small Witoto/Muenane nasal ornaments in chapterV printed86 and AppendixI printed275; user provided adult photographs also show green coronets, tall blue/red feathers, curved tooth pendants, contrasting body paint and cream fibre garments. The photograph of children is not sent to the API or copied. These character combinations are proposed, not a universal historical outfit, certified clan code, or literal reenactment of a contemporary photograph. No huge gold Moche-style nose plates, gold armour, modern bead ponchos, manufactured neon textiles or Nordic facial features. Nose ornaments are small quill/reed forms, not all characters share them.
Keep all requested ornaments physically built from individually cut dyed PAPER, especially feather vanes separated with raised central fold, serrated edges and visible thickness. Seed strings are separate tiny paper pieces; pigment is flat dark/red paper laid on skin, not painted CGI. Hair changes and naturally varied face widths/noses/lips distinguish actors; do not generate the same generic beautiful face.
